inputs.name: a run request from the Requesting Authority's Cell, naming the decided target operating model release to design from
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the HU input port at the tool gateway

inputs.name: the decided target operating model release with its role register, handed over directly by the part that made it, read role register first; with its strategy frame, delivery models, critical streams, journeys, priorities and activity profile, each read and never filled
inputs.format: release reference (ID + version + hash of its manifest), received through the Input socket from that part, through the tool gateway

inputs.name: the organisation's other sources, such as its existing processes, procedures, policies, volumes and times, by reference only, from the output socket of Source Lifecycle
inputs.format: source reference (ID + version + hash; held or not held), received through the Input socket

inputs.name: answers to needs requests, recorded as sources in Source Lifecycle
returns from the next stage on a release of this part, under the Library's design return contract
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) validating against library/contracts/design-return.schema.json, received through the tool gateway

outputs.name: returns to the part that made the target operating model release, under the Library's design return contract: accepted; cannot use, missing what; contradiction found; assumption invalid; request kind unsupported; each citing the elements it concerns, each ending in a decision
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) validating against library/contracts/design-return.schema.json, sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: needs requests to the Chief of Staff of Source Lifecycle, one thing and one decision per row
outputs.format: Work Item sub-items (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: a Process and Position Design release: process architecture, process book (each step with its done-when, worst error and reversibility, kinds of act, input source and trust, confidentiality, risks, controls and record), decision-rights register and authority matrix, policy register, controls catalogue with the segregation-of-duties check, position register with generated job descriptions and competence profiles, objectives cascade, unit register with generated unit charters, organisation charts, forums with charters and tiers, review calendar, structure scenarios when asked for, workload with the peak-load check and end-to-end times, crosswalk from the current organisation, walkthrough report and quality checks, and a decision package; each process with its re-approval date; positions only; decided element by element by the Requesting Authority; its objectives cascade starts from the decided strategy frame; each process and position carries the priority of the elements it carries; a capability delivered outside is a hand-off with oversight steps; today's activity profile is shown beside the designed workload, never about a person
outputs.format: frozen, content-addressed release (manifest + parts by hash), filed into Source Lifecycle as a source and handed to the next stage by reference

outputs.name: a release notice to Delivery and Implementation for each decided release, naming the target operating model release it rests on
outputs.format: release notice under the Library's release notice contract (library/contracts/release-notice.schema.json), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: the answer to each return from Delivery and Implementation, on the return itself: a new decided release, or the Requesting Authority's decision, including a decision to set it aside; every element carried forward on a set-aside return marked in the release with its basis
outputs.format: release reference or decision reference, recorded on the return

tool_roles: the output port of the part that made the target operating model release
the input port of Delivery and Implementation (release notices out, returns in)
source of record (the output socket of Source Lifecycle)
tool gateway (signatures, metering, the stop door)
